full_track.tags: K-Pop and J-Pop fusion with high-energy bubblegum pop elements. The arrangement features bright, layered synthesizers, a driving electronic drum kit with a crisp snare and punchy kick, and a prominent slap bass line that follows a syncopated funk pattern. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic staccato chords. The female vocals are energetic and bright, utilizing a wide melodic range with frequent shifts into a higher register. The tempo is 128 BPM in the key of E Major. The production is polished with heavy compression on the drums and shimmering reverb on the vocal tracks. The chorus features dense vocal layering and harmonized backing tracks.
